summary: Short, steepish residential kerb with parked cars; homes about 18-26 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Houses sit 18-26 m away on this side near the start; one is 6 m away at 40 m.

flags: Dwelling 6 m away at 40 m, so avoid the far end
